subject: $130 for the same coding job
preview: Copilot Pro is $10. Cursor Pro is $20. Claude Max starts at $100. Pay for all three and you are spending $130 a month so three products can fix the same bug.
lede: Copilot Pro is $10. Cursor Pro is $20. Claude Max starts at $100. Pay for all three and you are spending $130 a month so three products can fix the same bug. Grok SuperGrok is another $30 if it is sitting next to ChatGPT as a second chat window.
verification: Prices verified from official pages and Pricing Watch, rechecked 25 Aug 2026. ChatGPT US-dollar amounts were not reliably exposed on the official pricing page, so they are not listed here.

new_listings.name: HtmlSlides
new_listings.note: Pro is $9.90/month at launch. Interactive HTML decks. Test against Gamma on one real presentation before you add a seat. Novelty is not a job.

new_listings.name: Whop CLI
new_listings.note: $0 to install. Terminal control for Whop products and checkout. Relevant if you sell on Whop. Not a second subscription if you do not sell there.

watch_list.name: Grok
watch_list.note: Lineup last checked 2026-08-26. Confirm current Grok 4.6 / Grok Build names on X before SuperGrok becomes your second assistant.

watch_list.name: Cursor
watch_list.note: Composer moves. Re-run one real multi-file change before you renew Pro if Copilot or Claude already lives in the same repo.

watch_list.name: ChatGPT
watch_list.note: Recorded as the GPT-5.4 family as of 2026-08-26. Verify openai.com/pricing before you gift them an annual. No US-dollar Plus/Pro amount is listed here because it was not reliably exposed.

watch_list.name: Claude
watch_list.note: Chat plan and Claude Code are not the same job. Do not assume one invoice covers both personalities.

keep_one.title: Claude Code vs Cursor vs Copilot
keep_one.rule: Keep one paid coding surface. Copilot for inline completions in the editor you already have. Cursor if you want an AI-native IDE. Claude Code if the job is a terminal agent on a repo. Paying for two is overlap. Paying for three is $130 a month for the same bug.

protocol: Forty-five minutes. One real bugfix. Run it in each seat you actually pay for. Score first-output acceptance and edit burden. Keep the winner. Cancel the rest 48 hours before renewal.
keep_cut_rule: One weekly job. One paid tool. If two invoices own the same Friday, one of them is leaving.
